title: gentiana asclepiadea subsp. schistocalyx
intro: Gentiana asclepiadea subsp. schistocalyx, commonly known as the Schistocalyx Gentian, is a plant species in the Gentianaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The Schistocalyx Gentian has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it beneficial for wound healing, reducing fever, and combating infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gentiopicroside, loganic acid, and gentianine, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
